WITH july15_temps AS (
  SELECT

  FROM meteo_tmean AS mt

    july15_temps.longitude AS longitude,
    july15_temps.tmean_c AS tmean_c
  FROM july15_temps
  WHERE
    july15_temps.tmean_k = (
      SELECT
        max_temp_value.highest_tmean_k AS highest_tmean_k
      FROM max_temp_value
    )
), level1_counts AS (
  SELECT
    h.latitude AS latitude,
    h.longitude AS longitude,
    lt.level1_code AS level1_code,
    lt.level1_label AS level1_label,

    h.longitude,
    lt.level1_code,

  SELECT
    level1_counts.latitude AS latitude,
    level1_counts.longitude AS longitude,
    level1_counts.level1_code AS level1_code,
    level1_counts.level1_label AS level1_label,
    level1_counts.total_count AS total_count,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY level1_counts.latitude, level1_counts.longitude
      ORDER BY level1_counts.total_count DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM level1_counts

    d.latitude AS latitude,
    d.longitude AS longitude,
    d.level1_code AS level1_code,
    d.level1_label AS dominant_level1_type,
    d.total_count AS dominant_count,
    ROUND(CAST(h.tmean_c AS DECIMAL), 2) AS highest_avg_temp_c

  JOIN hottest_grid AS h

  WHERE
    d.rnk = 1
